records.text: The Unification movement bought land, buildings, blocks, and companies while Sun Myung Moon presented himself as a messiah.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They were buying up land, buildings, entire blocks, all these different companies while convincing the masses that it was actually for the father. ... Moon had minted himself as a messiah.

verification.notes: Independent reporting documents extensive Unification-linked property and business holdings, while Moon’s movement and public declarations presented him as a messianic figure.
